observations: Photo 0: Closed silver Dell laptop, lid shows Dell logo and a small circular sticker. A handwritten note is visible on the top right corner of the lid.

Photo 1: Open laptop showing Windows desktop, 14-inch screen, black keyboard, silver chassis, Dell logo below screen. A small sticker with 'CORE i7 10th' is visible on the bottom right of the palm rest.
Photo 2: Bottom of the laptop showing vents, regulatory labels, and a handwritten note. The model name 'Latitude 7410' is visible on the bottom panel near the center.
All photos show the same laptop from different angles, held by a hand with a brown leather watch.

Photo 1: Sticker on palm rest reads 'CORE i7 10th'.

risks.risk: The SSD capacity and RAM are not visible or confirmed; could be less than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the system information screen (e.g., Windows 'About' page) or the BIOS showing RAM and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if 256GB SSD and 8GB RAM are not guaranteed, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The laptop may have physical damage not visible in photos, such as hinge wear, screen dead pixels, or keyboard issues.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the screen (checking for dead pixels), hinges, and keyboard under different lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if there may be hidden physical defects, reducing value.

risks.risk: The battery may be degraded or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop running on battery with battery percentage and time remaining displayed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if battery is not working or degraded, which affects usability and value.

proof_requests: Photo or video of the system information screen showing RAM and storage details.
Close-up video of the screen under different lighting to check for dead pixels or flickering.
Video of the laptop running on battery with battery percentage and time shown.
Photo of the full handwritten note on the bottom (photo 2) to read any specs written there.
response.reason: The model and processor are confirmed from photos. The screen size is consistent with the model. RAM and SSD are unverified but typical for this model; the item can be priced at its worst case (e.g., 256GB SSD and 8GB RAM not guaranteed). Hidden risks like battery health and physical defects are noted but do not prevent pricing, as they are common in used laptops and priced accordingly.
